description: Notion 요약의 담당 없는 액션 아이템 둘이 전사에서 다른 사람(Maya · Sam)이 맡은 일로 드러난다. 사용자의 할 일은 없고, 확인 요청도 남지 않아야 한다. 사용자의 "once they're in"은 조건부라 할 일이 아니다.

sources.text:
# Onboarding flow sync

Meeting 2026-10-06

[AI 요약]
    ### Summary
    - The team agreed to cut the signup form down to three fields.
    - Usability test results will be reviewed at the next sync.
    ### Action items
    - [ ] Share usability test results (Thursday)
    - [ ] Update signup form copy

[메모]

[녹음 전사]

[Google Meet · Onboarding flow sync]
Maya Chen: So we're cutting the signup form down to three fields. I'll share the usability test results by Thursday.
Alex Kim: Great, thanks. I'll take a look once they're in.
Sam Rivera: And I'm already updating the signup form copy, so that one's covered.
Maya Chen: Perfect. Let's go through everything at next week's sync.
